cases.question: 전체 국가의 HS2022 330499·854231·150910 수출 합계가 2024년 2월 대비 2025년 2월 얼마나 늘었는지로 상위 2개국을 정해줘. 국가코드, 증가액 USD 순서, 증가액 동률이면 코드 오름차순.

observed_sql.sql: WITH feb_2025 AS (SELECT em.country_code, SUM(em.amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2025 FROM export_monthly AS em JOIN country AS c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28' AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND em.hs6_code IN ('330499', '854231', '150910') GROUP BY em.country_code), feb_2024 AS (SELECT em.country_code, SUM(em.amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2024 FROM export_monthly AS em JOIN country AS c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29' AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND em.hs6_code IN ('330499', '854231', '150910') GROUP BY em.country_code) SELECT f25.country_code AS country_code, (COALESCE(f25.amount_usd_2025, 0) - COALESCE(f24.amount_usd_2024, 0)) AS increase_usd FROM feb_2025 AS f25 LEFT JOIN feb_2024 AS f24 ON f25.country_code = f24.country_code UNION ALL SELECT f24.country_code AS country_code, (0 - COALESCE(f24.amount_usd_2024, 0)) AS increase_usd FROM feb_2024 AS f24 LEFT JOIN feb_2025 AS f25 ON f24.country_code = f25.country_code WHERE f25.country_code IS NULL ORDER BY increase_usd DESC, country_code ASC LIMIT 2

draft.sql:
WITH feb_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    em.country_code,
    SUM(em.amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2025
  FROM export_monthly em
  JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
  WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28'
    AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND em.hs6_code IN ('330499', '854231', '150910')
  GROUP BY em.country_code
),
feb_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    em.country_code,
    SUM(em.amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2024
  FROM export_monthly em
  JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
  WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
    AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND em.hs6_code IN ('330499', '854231', '150910')
  GROUP BY em.country_code
)
SELECT
  f25.country_code AS country_code,
  (COALESCE(f25.amount_usd_2025, 0) - COALESCE(f24.amount_usd_2024, 0)) AS increase_usd
FROM feb_2025 f25
LEFT JOIN feb_2024 f24 ON f25.country_code = f24.country_code
UNION ALL
SELECT
  f24.country_code AS country_code,
  (0 - COALESCE(f24.amount_usd_2024, 0)) AS increase_usd
FROM feb_2024 f24
LEFT JOIN feb_2025 f25 ON f24.country_code = f25.country_code
WHERE f25.country_code IS NULL
ORDER BY increase_usd DESC, country_code ASC
LIMIT 2;
draft.summary: 2024년 2월 대비 2025년 2월 HS2022 330499, 854231, 150910 수출 합계 증가액 기준 상위 2개국을 국가코드, 증가액 USD 순서(동률시 코드 오름차순)로 반환합니다.

cases.question: 2025년 2월 HS2022 전체 품목 수출을 미국+독일은 A그룹, 중국+일본은 B그룹으로 합쳐줘. 그룹명과 합계 USD 두 열이고 A, B 순서야.

observed_sql.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN em.country_code IN ('US', 'DE') THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS group_name, SUM(em.amount_usd) AS total_usd FROM export_monthly AS em JOIN country AS c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28' AND em.country_code IN ('US', 'DE', 'CN', 'JP') AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022' GROUP BY group_name ORDER BY group_name LIMIT 2

draft.sql:
WITH filtered_export AS (
  SELECT em.country_code, SUM(em.amount_usd) AS total_usd
  FROM export_monthly em
  JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28'
    AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
    AND em.country_code IN ('US', 'DE', 'CN', 'JP')
  GROUP BY em.country_code
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN country_code IN ('US', 'DE') THEN 'A'
    WHEN country_code IN ('CN', 'JP') THEN 'B'
  END AS group_name,
  SUM(total_usd) AS sum_usd
FROM filtered_export
GROUP BY group_name
ORDER BY FIELD(group_name, 'A', 'B')
LIMIT 2;
draft.summary: 2025년 2월 미국+독일(A), 중국+일본(B) 그룹별 전체 수출 합계(USD)를 반환합니다.

draft.sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN em.country_code IN ('US', 'DE') THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS group_name,
  SUM(em.amount_usd) AS total_usd
FROM export_monthly em
JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
WHERE em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-02-28'
  AND em.country_code IN ('US', 'DE', 'CN', 'JP')
  AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
GROUP BY group_name
ORDER BY group_name
LIMIT 2;

cases.question: 독일 전체 품목(HS2022) 수출의 2024년 2~3월과 2025년 1~2월을 각 기간의 첫달끼리, 둘째달끼리 맞춰 비교해줘. 표만 필요해. 구간명(첫달/둘째달), 2024년 USD, 2025년 USD 순서.

observed_sql.sql: WITH export_2025 AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, SUM(amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2025 FROM export_monthly AS em JOIN country AS c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE em.country_code = 'DE' AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-02-28' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m')), export_2024 AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m') AS month_str, SUM(amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2024 FROM export_monthly AS em JOIN country AS c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY' WHERE em.country_code = 'DE' AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022' AND em.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m')) SELECT CASE WHEN e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01' THEN '첫달' WHEN e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02' THEN '둘째달' ELSE NULL END AS period_label, e24.amount_usd_2024 AS amount_usd_2024, e25.amount_usd_2025 AS amount_usd_2025 FROM export_2024 AS e24 JOIN export_2025 AS e25 ON ((e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01') OR (e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02')) WHERE ((e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01') OR (e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02')) ORDER BY period_label LIMIT 2

WITH export_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m') AS month_str,
    SUM(amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2025
  FROM export_monthly em
  JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
  WHERE em.country_code = 'DE'
    AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND em.trade_month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-02-28'
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m')
),
export_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m') AS month_str,
    SUM(amount_usd) AS amount_usd_2024
  FROM export_monthly em
  JOIN country c ON em.country_code = c.country_code AND c.country_role = 'COUNTRY'
  WHERE em.country_code = 'DE'
    AND em.hs_ver = 'HS2022'
    AND em.trade_month BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-03-31'
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(trade_month, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01' THEN '첫달'
    WHEN e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02' THEN '둘째달'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS period_label,
  e24.amount_usd_2024 AS amount_usd_2024,
  e25.amount_usd_2025 AS amount_usd_2025
FROM export_2024 e24
JOIN export_2025 e25
  ON (
    (e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01')
    OR (e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02')
  )
WHERE ( (e24.month_str = '2024-02' AND e25.month_str = '2025-01')
     OR (e24.month_str = '2024-03' AND e25.month_str = '2025-02') )
ORDER BY period_label
LIMIT 2;
